name: pgokf
abstract: Materialized PostgreSQL catalog for Open Knowledge Format bundles
description: pgokf materializes Open Knowledge Format (OKF) bundles -- directories of UTF-8 Markdown concept documents with YAML frontmatter -- into a transactional, queryable PostgreSQL catalog with native full-text search and link-graph traversal. The on-disk bundle remains the portable source of truth; PostgreSQL becomes a projection optimized for metadata queries. Built with Rust and pgrx; no third-party search extension is required.
